snapshot.text: Health system organised around a National Health Service (SNS) that depends heavily on donor money. Main challenges: too few health workers and uneven staffing, roughly 92,000 new HIV infections a year, and falling external funding that threatens gains on HIV, malaria, TB and maternal health. priorities.title: Pooling health financing to cut duplication
priorities.text: The government is pursuing a plan to coordinate and merge health funding streams, aiming to reduce duplicated planning and sustain the National Health Service despite tighter budgets.

priorities.title: Climate-proofing health services
priorities.text: Maputo plans to commit about 235 million US dollars to shield the health sector from climate shocks such as cyclones, floods and droughts, with an estimated 30,000 deaths targeted for prevention.

priorities.title: Health workforce investment dialogue
priorities.text: A national dialogue held in March 2026 brought together policymakers and partners to address health worker shortages and uneven distribution, with universal health coverage by 2030 as the stated goal.

netherlands.text: The Netherlands has cooperated with Mozambique on health for decades, and its embassy says it keeps investing strongly in health and sexual and reproductive rights.
